reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to The Insight by Oak Tree Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to The Insight by Oak Tree Capital. I'm Anna Schimansky, Oak Tree's senior financial writer, and today I'm in Los Angeles at Oak Tree's Client Conference. We'll consider why markets performed so well in recent months, despite all of the uncertainty, and we'll dig into some important trends in liquid credit.

key_points.text: I'm Anna Schimansky, Oak Tree's senior financial writer, and today I'm in Los Angeles at Oak Tree's Client Conference.
